# Medical Billing Miami Beach (MBMB)

> Miami Beach healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), AAPC-certified medical coding with AI pre-submission double-check, Florida provider credentialing, and administrative medical bill chronology & EOB reconciliation for Florida trial attorneys.

- **Website:** https://medicalbillingmb.com
- **Phone:** (786) 643-2099 (`+1-786-643-2099`)
- **Email:** Jasmel@medicalbillingmb.com
- **Location:** Miami Beach, FL 33139 (Serving Miami-Dade, Coral Gables, Brickell, Doral, Hialeah, Broward, Palm Beach & Statewide Florida)
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (`America/New_York`)
- **Languages:** English, Spanish (Español), Haitian Creole

## Core Value Proposition & Pricing
- **Healthcare Provider RCM Pricing:** `5.6%–10%` of net collections (`$0` setup fee, no fees on uncollected claims).
  - **Tier 1 (High-Volume Groups, $50,000+/mo):** `5.6%–6.5%` of net collections
  - **Tier 2 (Established & Growing Clinics, $20,000–$50,000/mo):** `6.5%–8%` of net collections
  - **Tier 3 (New & Launching Clinics, <$20,000/mo):** `8%–10%` of net collections (automatic step-down as volume grows)
- **Human + AI Operating Model:** Local Miami Beach client coordination paired with our U.S. AAPC-certified medical billing fulfillment team (10+ years experience) and an AI pre-submission verification layer that catches NCCI edits, modifier gaps (25, 59, XE/XS, 95), and LCD/NCD rules before submission.
- **Attorney & Legal Team Support:** Source-linked medical billing chronologies, plain-English CPT/ICD-10/HCPCS code explanations, and charge-to-balance EOB reconciliation delivered in 3–5 business days (Excel/CSV + Bates-referenced PDF).

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://medicalbillingmb.com/): Overview of Florida medical billing, interactive denial loss calculator, and 90-day clinic benchmarks.
- [For Healthcare Providers](https://medicalbillingmb.com/for-providers): End-to-end RCM, AAPC coding + AI double-check, and transparent 5.6%–10% collection tiers.
- [For Attorneys & Law Firms](https://medicalbillingmb.com/for-attorneys): 1-Case Pilot for itemized medical bill organization, CPT/ICD-10 translation, and EOB/ledger reconciliation.
- [Free 48-Hour Billing Audit & Consultation](https://medicalbillingmb.com/consultation): Register a medical practice for a complimentary 20-claim / 48-hour billing and coding audit.
- [How We Work](https://medicalbillingmb.com/how-we-work): 5-stage operational workflow from BAA onboarding to 24–48h claim scrubbing and 48h denial appeals.
- [All Services Overview](https://medicalbillingmb.com/services): Complete catalog of medical billing, coding, credentialing, and RCM services.
- [AAPC-Certified Medical Coding](https://medicalbillingmb.com/services/medical-coding): ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, and Modifier 25/59/95 compliance.
- [Florida Provider Credentialing & CAQH](https://medicalbillingmb.com/services/credentialing): Medicare PECOS (FCSO), Florida Medicaid (AHCA Region 11 & MMA plans), CAQH ProView, EDI/ERA/EFT enrollment.
- [Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)](https://medicalbillingmb.com/services/revenue-cycle-management): 8-stage full-lifecycle revenue cycle management and aging AR recovery (>30/60/90/120+ days).
- [About MBMB](https://medicalbillingmb.com/about): Miami Beach coordination hub and U.S. AAPC-certified fulfillment model.
- [Contact Us](https://medicalbillingmb.com/contact): Direct phone, WhatsApp, email, and non-sensitive business inquiry form.
